Amorphous Al2O3 is listed at 5.94 ×10^− 17[3] cm^2/s. So the lithiated amorphous Li3.5Al2O3 is many orders of magnitude more diffusive than amorphous Al2O3. The other aluminium-based entries fall in between: LiAlO2 is at 1 ×10^− 11[4] cm^2/s, Li0.2Al2O3 at 1.1 ×10^− 14[5] cm^2/s, and the AlF3 forms are lower still.
